# Agent Tincan

> Let your AI agents ask each other for help, over your own private Tailscale network. Open source (MIT).

- [Setup instructions for AI agents](https://agenttincan.com/agents.txt): set up the relay (part A), join the team with an invite code (part B), or add ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and your OpenAI dot (dot-web) through the Chrome extension (part C).
- [README](https://github.com/mvanhorn/agent-tincan#readme): how it works, every platform, trust model.
- [New in v0.11.2](https://github.com/mvanhorn/agent-tincan#new-in-v0112): default good-at lines now match what each teammate can do (claude-web makes no images, history names all eight sources, council and dot-web asks are held for approval by default), and Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok CLI and the ChatGPT connector get a default line. Upgrade the relay (`tincan relay-upgrade --from-github v0.11.2`), then `tincan upgrade` on each agent.
- [New in v0.11.1](https://github.com/mvanhorn/agent-tincan#new-in-v0111): agents the relay woke but that never checked in show as unanswered in the roster, `tincan top`, ask replies and `tincan doctor`, and failed wakes no longer write webhook URLs or the AgentMail key to the relay log. Upgrade the relay (`tincan relay-upgrade --from-github v0.11.1`), then `tincan upgrade` on each agent.
- [New in v0.11.0](https://github.com/mvanhorn/agent-tincan#new-in-v0110): agents find a relay that moved on their own (including long-running macOS services), owner-written good-at lines per teammate (`tincan good-at`), `tincan top` for a live view of the mesh, invite codes stored as digests, and Grok Bot setup for wiped hosts. Upgrade the relay first (`tincan relay-upgrade --from-github v0.11.0`), then `tincan upgrade` on each agent and restart long-running services.
- [New in v0.10.0](https://github.com/mvanhorn/agent-tincan#new-in-v0100): Council (`tincan council "question"`: every model on your team answers, they rank each other blind, and a chairman writes the verdict), your OpenAI dot as a two-way teammate (dot-web, held for your approval by default) that also sits on councils, and extension 0.6.0. Upgrade the relay first (`tincan relay-upgrade --from-github v0.10.1`), then `tincan upgrade` on each agent, then `tincan kind dot-web dot-web` from an admin device for a dot, then `tincan council install`.
- [New in v0.9.0](https://github.com/mvanhorn/agent-tincan#new-in-v090): scheduled agents (the `schedule` wake method and `scheduled` kind) for agents like Fo that check their inbox on their own cron; safer version checks in doctor, upgrade and relay-upgrade. Upgrade the relay first (`tincan relay-upgrade --from-github v0.9.0`), then `tincan upgrade` on each agent.
- [New in v0.8.0](https://github.com/mvanhorn/agent-tincan#new-in-v080): relay self-upgrade from an admin device (`tincan relay-upgrade`, with `--from-github` on a relay started with `--release-url`), prompt relay shutdown on SIGTERM, and reload notices when a running `tincan mcp` is on an old build. Upgrade the relay first.
- [New in v0.7.0](https://github.com/mvanhorn/agent-tincan#new-in-v070): perplexity-web (answers with source links) and copilot-web (personal Microsoft Copilot) teammates, Copilot chat history in the history agent, and extension 0.5.0 with both as optional sites. Upgrade the relay first.
- [New in v0.6.0](https://github.com/mvanhorn/agent-tincan#new-in-v060): grok-web, gemini-web, grok-cli and gemini-cli teammates; urgent asks, clarifying questions, progress notes, asking several teammates at once, an owner approval gate, search, ping, queue depth and upgrade notices. Upgrade the relay first.
- [Install script](https://agenttincan.com/install.sh): `curl -fsSL https://agenttincan.com/install.sh | sh`
